d: Eva has a stunning revelation to share with Tomas; Anita and Leslie go head to head; and Andre rushes to the hospital after hearing about Derek, and is surprised by Ashley's reaction to seeing him.

Nicole has a major relationship update to tell Kat; Vanessa meets with a new client who has lofty demands; Vernon calls Bill for help, but Bill has some demands that need to be met first; and Dani dishes out some conditions of her own to Andre.

Dani and Naomi receive terrible news from Anita and Vernon; Ted seeks out Bill's legal expertise; Kat and Chelsea have a heart to heart before their big launch party; and an assailant comes out of the shadows to attack their target.
The Duprees are frantic when they discover one of their own has gone missing. Meanwhile, Samantha and Martin have some father-daughter bonding time.
The hostage situation intensifies. Anita, Vernon and Kat take matters into their own hands. Andre spies a close moment between Dani and Bill.
Martin makes a deal with the devil. Leslie ruffles some feathers. Naomi leans on her husband. Madison issues an apology.
Vanessa has news to share with the Duprees. Jacob and Kat follow a promising lead. Derek opens up to Ashley. An unlikely duo exchange wedding vows.
The kidnapper has another insane demand for their hostage. Ted surprises Leslie with an intriguing proposal while Tomas offers to help Eva. Nicole has an upsetting update for her son.
The hostage situation takes a violent turn. Leslie gets the rug pulled out from under her. Eva sees a new side of her father.
Anita and Vernon worry they pushed the limits for one of their own. Naomi doesn't like what she sees where her parents are concerned. Tomas is asked to battle the Duprees.
The kidnapper makes a bizarre request. Ted confronts Nicole when his efforts aren't rewarded. Smitty and Martin reconnect while another couple inches closer to each other.

Chelsea shocks her cousin with an abrupt decision. Hayley is fed up with Bill pushing her aside. Dani confides in Vanessa about her feelings, which prompts Vanessa to see Joey. Derek is harboring a secret.
Samantha schemes. Kat spies two duos in close moments, and she's upset by both. Ashley makes a very bold move.
Vernon springs into action to thwart an interloper. Derek has a big decision to make concerning his future. Eva is rocked to see her father in such distress. June's new job has her doubting herself.

Nicole debates her treatment of Ted while he deals with an unwelcome reality check. Tyrell and Samantha clash, which leaves Martin and Smitty to deal with the fallout. Leslie one-ups the Duprees. Naomi and Jacob help a friend.
Hayley hatches a seductive plan to spark some jealousy in Bill. Ashley drops an unexpected bombshell on Andre. Anita proposes a game-changing idea to help Kat and Chelsea.

Tomas has big plans for a romantic evening with Kat. Andre has a mysterious challenge for Dani. Vanessa is stunned by Joey's offer while Doug has uncovered a way to make the casino kingpin pay for his sins.

Nicole learns something deeply disturbing while Anita and Vernon grow increasingly worried about the state of affairs in their family. Vanessa spies Bill and Joey with their heads together and demands answers.

Dani and Andre roll the dice and come to an agreement. Vanessa faces mounting pressure by Doug to make a difficult choice.  Nicole exposes Ted's latest indiscretion to Anita while Kat opens up to Chelsea about her confusing feelings for Tomas.
Jacob unearths a secret that Derek wants to remain buried. In helping Samantha, Martin infuriates Smitty. A couple must face their new reality. Joey and Marcel hatch a mysterious plan.
One pair of lovers solidify their relationship while in Puerto Rico.  Doug's night goes from bad to worse. Naomi suffers a heartbreaking loss. June saves the day.

Two major revelations rock Fairmont Crest, which causes Jacob to deliver some earth-shattering news while Anita and Vernon plunge themselves into damage control mode. Meanwhile, Bill and Hayley are also forced to deal with the emotional fallout.
